newsitem.title: FRANCE: French fin min - no jobless fall till end-98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: French fin min - no jobless fall till end-98 - paper.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said in a newspaper interview published on Wednesday he did not expect France's unemployment rate, now 12.5 percent, to fall before the end of 1998.
"I think unemployment will be flat at the same level for some time and will decrease from its current level at the end of 1998," he said in an interview with the International Herald Tribune.

Plans to cut the budget deficit this year by 32 billion francs, announced on Monday, would not "do anything directly" for unemployment" but "we have to reduce the deficit, which indirectly has a positive effect", he said.
"We have to make people more employable, which means not only more skills but more geographic mobility," he added.
